inputs.value: An advertising photograph for a new perfume. It should feel refined and calm, while remaining warm and approachable. Create a tactile image that helps viewers imagine picking up the bottle in everyday life. Use a composition that clearly shows the shape of the bottle.

Perfume product photography, amber glass bottle resting on natural linen, warm soft window light.
Close view at table height, delicate glass reflections, a quiet lived-in setting, generous negative space.

Luxury perfume campaign, a glass bottle on a polished black marble plinth.
Hard spotlight, deep shadows, high contrast, monumental low angle, immaculate geometric symmetry.

Perfume bottle suspended underwater, ribbons of blue light, crystalline caustics.
Surreal floating composition, crisp glass edges, cool silver highlights, dramatic deep blue background.

inputs.instructions: Choose the concept that best fits the creative intent. Judge the impression created by lighting, materials, and composition rather than matching keywords. Consider approachability and tactile appeal as well as a sense of luxury.
